title: Apex Programme Catalogue / Lyrix
summary: Public catalogue entry for the Lyrix biological pilot programme.
body:
PROGRAMME CATALOGUE

LYRIX

The Lyrix programme is identified in surviving Apex records as a specialised pilot-development programme involving biological modification and Echo transit training.

The public catalogue contains no individual subject files and does not provide operational details.

The programme's military classification varies between archival copies.

ARCHIVE NOTE

Brightside retains a withdrawn programme record under ARC-326-0425.
